name: Rolling Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"

  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  Build:
    permissions: write-all
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository == 'GUI-for-Cores/GUI.for.SingBox'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: latest
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "latest"
          cache: "pnpm"
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cd frontend && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build Frontend
        run: cd frontend && pnpm build-only
      - name: Create a compressed file
        run: |
          git rev-parse --short HEAD | tr -d '
' > frontend/dist/version.txt
          cd frontend
          mv dist rolling-release
          zip -r rolling-release.zip rolling-release
      - name: Generate Changelog
        run: |
          set +e
          LAST_COMMIT=$(curl -L https://github.com/GUI-for-Cores/GUI.for.SingBox/releases/download/rolling-release/version.txt)
          echo -e "## Change log

> Update time: $(TZ='Asia/Shanghai' date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
" > changelog.md
          git log $LAST_COMMIT..HEAD --pretty=format:"* %s" >> changelog.md
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "No changes found since last commit." >> changelog.md
          fi
          set -e
      - name: Create Release and Upload Assets
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: ./{frontend/{rolling-release.zip,rolling-release/version.txt},changelog.md}
          file_glob: true
          tag: rolling-release
          release_name: rolling-release
          overwrite: true
          draft: false
          prerelease: true
          body: |
            Rolling release built by GitHub Actions.
            To use this version, please install the "Rolling Release Assistant" plugin and enable "Enable Rolling Release" within the app.

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
